classification.difficultyReason: Three linked steps. Read the ticks as equal chords, so equal central angles that split 140° into 70° each. Then use the isosceles triangle OAB.

content.prompt: $O$ is the centre of the circle. Find the size of $\angle OAB$.

answer.worked:
$AB=BC$, so they subtend equal angles at the centre.
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=\frac{140^\circ}{2}\\&=70^\circ\end{align*}$$
$OA=OB$ (radii), so the base angles of $\triangle AOB$ are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\angle OAB&=\frac{180^\circ-70^\circ}{2}\\&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
